# Aditya Mali Portfolio & Software Café

> Developer portfolio and software by Aditya Mali.

## Kill9 for macOS

Kill9 is a native macOS menu bar developer utility by Aditya Mali, built with SwiftUI and AppKit. It discovers processes listening on local TCP ports, identifies associated development projects when metadata is available, and lets users stop those processes through a graphical interface. Its main use cases are freeing occupied development ports and resolving local port conflicts such as EADDRINUSE.

- [Official Kill9 product page, installation, Terminal guide, and FAQ](https://www.adityamali.com/cafe/kill9)
- [Kill9 source code and technical documentation](https://github.com/adityamali/kill9)
- [Detailed Kill9 summary](https://www.adityamali.com/llms-full.txt)

Compatibility: macOS 13.0 or later, Apple silicon and Intel. No Windows or Linux version. Stop sends SIGTERM. If the process remains, Force becomes available and sends SIGKILL only when clicked. Escalation is not automatic. Stopping a process affects all ports it owns.
